title: Cancelling an order
text: An order can be cancelled for a full refund within 60 seconds of placing it. After the restaurant starts preparing the food, cancellation is not possible. If the order is delayed by more than 30 minutes beyond the promised time, the customer can cancel and receive a full refund.

title: Refunds
text: Refunds for missing, wrong or damaged items are issued to the original payment method within 5 to 7 working days, or instantly to the in-app wallet. Report the issue within 24 hours of delivery with a photo of the item.

title: Delivery fee
text: Orders with an item total of ₹199 or more get free delivery. Orders below ₹199 have a delivery fee of ₹30. There is no surge fee in this demo.

title: Late delivery
text: Every order shows an estimated delivery time. If the order arrives more than 15 minutes late, the customer receives a ₹50 coupon automatically.

title: Allergies and dietary needs
text: Dish descriptions list main ingredients but kitchens handle nuts, dairy and gluten. Customers with severe allergies should contact the restaurant before ordering. Items marked veg contain no meat, fish or egg.

title: Ordering from one restaurant
text: A cart can contain items from only one restaurant at a time. To order from another restaurant, clear the cart first or place the current order.

title: Payment methods
text: Orders can be paid by UPI, credit or debit card, net banking or cash on delivery. Cash on delivery is available for orders up to ₹2,000.

title: Order tracking
text: After placing an order, its status moves from Confirmed to Preparing, then Out for delivery, then Delivered. The app shows the current status and estimated time.
